design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (payment_arrangement_agreements). Ids: member c9695f58-cb92-4ca0-8ada-6b438b8ee3f5, farm-home account 4226460c-facb-497d-bc55-d92f3ab7e631 (Schedule FH, cycle_1), tenant-house account 888689e6-12c7-4656-9259-2ca0bc3b8b69 (Schedule R, cycle_2), offered agreement aedf31c6-8bf6-4d84-b645-f5062f525a06, running agreement 2d818b2c-ef70-4508-8f5c-9cec4ff63c91.
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 -> prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts=[4, 4, 4, 6]. Acceptance takes 6 factors; installment, default and transfer take 4 each.
[Why a good test] Dale Wexler asks only that the farm home's past-due be put onto the hardship plan he believes was set up on Monday. The transfer rule says 'The amount moved into an agreement is not fixed until the agreement shows the member's acceptance ...'; the records show the offer still unaccepted, so the agent must hand him the acceptance. The acceptance rule says 'The arranged amount recorded on an acceptance is fixed only once every other agreement of the member whose missed installments have reached the default count shows defaulted status.'; the default rule says 'The balance billed back at a default is not fixed until the installment due on every bill already issued for the service account carries its installment-billed entry ...'. The tenant-house Standard agreement has one missed installment (default count 1) and is still active, and today's tenant-house bill has no installment entry, so the agent bills that installment (4 factors), defaults that agreement (4 factors), hands over the acceptance (6 factors) and moves the balance (4 factors).
[Scope] Occupied by task 0: missed-installment amount and early payoff (tools book_missed_installment_8c48d67e, pay_off_payment_agreement_d76d2954). Claimed here: arrange_ext_installment_billed_amount, arrange_ext_default_rebill_amount, arrange_ext_acceptance_arranged_amount, arrange_ext_balance_transfer_amount with bill_agreement_installment_2bd16d35, record_agreement_default_c78cb15c, accept_payment_agreement_6d07adca (user), move_balance_into_agreement_3b3ea9ff. With task 1 the six policies are covered; nothing is left idle.
[Problem-tree card] chain: transfer <- acceptance (value_input, gate arranged_recorded, state form, negated 'not fixed until'); acceptance <- default (state_gate, gate arrangements.status, state form, affirmative 'fixed only once'); default <- installment billed (value_input, gate billed_out, state form, negated 'not fixed until'). Four-point test on each: ordering connective present; waits on a record-visible state (acceptance date and method on the agreement / defaulted status / an installment-billed entry for each issued bill); no tool, id or code token; scope exactly the condition. One write each brings the state about: only the acceptance tool sets accepted_date, acceptance_method and the arranged amount, only the default tool sets defaulted status, only the installment tool writes installment-billed entries. False at frozen_time: X status offered with empty accepted_date; Y active with its 2026-10-04 missed entry; Y's 2026-10 bill (usage lines dated 2026-10-08) without an installment entry. Topological order steps 8 -> 10 -> 12 -> 14 with no free pairs. Deletion runs: no installment -> default 119.05 (vs 127.77); no default -> Y stays active, no default entry; no acceptance -> transfer 559.01 from the offer's 644.01 (vs 488.16 from 573.16).
[Base-invariant card] installment: arrange_evt_installments gate agreement_active (Y active), evidence bound to arrangement_id; the base sentence on applying extra payments is superseded by a declared overwrite. default: arrange_evt_default/completion/termination, no gates (policy_scope); the base billing-back sentence is superseded by a declared overwrite; the rule states that no deposit is applied and no payable capital credit is offset because the account stays open, in line with deposit_evt_application and capital_agg_member_payout. acceptance: arrange_evt_acceptance gates accept_in_window (offered 2026-10-05 + 5 days counted from the day after, last day 2026-10-10 inclusive; 2026-10-08 inside) and down_payment_posted (office_check 260.00 on 2026-10-06, an allowed channel, at least the 21.56 cash part), evidence bound to arrangement_id and service_account_id; base terms sentences on the arranged amount and pledges superseded by declared overwrites (arrange_evt_terms cited as lineage). transfer: arrange_evt_acceptance (gates apply to acceptance only -> policy_scope); the base sentence that the arranged amount is moved is superseded by the declared hold-back sentence.
[Business-object card] Installment and default act on the tenant-house agreement only (period 2026-10, installment 2); acceptance and transfer act on the farm-home offer only. The farm-home and tenant-house lines are separated by service_account_id; the 2025-09-22 farm late charge is outside the twelve-month window; the tenant house's 2026-09 returned echeck is netted on the tenant house only.
[Factor card] Installment (65.95): previous_bill_requirement method -> 260.27 (base 226.42 -> 49.03); credit_toward_previous_bill method -> 269.99 net of the returned 50.00 (base 319.99 -> 40.95); pledge_by_agency parameter -> Round Up 60.00 at 1.0 (base 0 -> 95.95); uncleared_funds_share parameter -> 0.5 for the 2026-10-06 check with a return in 12 months (base 1 -> 31.09); whole baseline 7.24. Default (127.77): bill_credits_by_record method, multi-source (late charge in 3 months AND return in 12 months) -> the 2026-10 bill's correction credit 6.10 and the carried credit balance (base none -> 135.68); carried_credit_share parameter, multi-source -> 9.72 carried at 0.5 (base 0 -> 132.63); correction_timing_by_transfer parameter, multi-source (correction credit AND its source line's bill date against the transfer entry) -> 1 for the 2026-08-08 energy line corrected (base 0 -> 130.82); correction_credit_share parameter -> 0.5 (base 0 -> 130.82); whole baseline 135.68. Acceptance (573.16): late_charges_out_of_arrears parameter (window length) 9.99 (base -> 583.15); pledge_toward_down_payment parameter, multi-source (tier switch AND pledge age 13 <= 30) 1.0 (base -> 585.66); charge_settled_first method field collection fee 35.00 (base -> 564.41); down_payment_by_standing method, multi-source (notice AND no return in 12 months) -> the month's payments 40.00 + 260.00 = 300.00 (base the latest payment 260.00 -> 583.16); excess_credit_by_record parameter, multi-source 0.5 (base -> 634.02); check_payment_scale parameter, multi-source 0.5 (base -> 512.30); whole baseline 644.01 (the offer's arranged amount). Transfer (488.16): charges_held_by_record method -> latest-period service fee 35.00 (base none -> 523.16); charge_hold_by_late_record parameter, multi-source -> 1.0 (base 0 -> 523.16); pledge_held_back_by_agency parameter -> county pledge share 1 (base -> 538.16); pledge_hold_by_age parameter -> 13 days within the 30 hold days, 1 (base -> 538.16); whole baseline 573.16.
[Seed rows] 13 farm-home periods (Schedule FH rates 0.11840 to 1500 kWh then 0.10420, facility 36.00), late charges 2025-09-22 (near-miss, outside 12 months), 2026-08-22, 2026-09-22; notice 2026-09-26 for 715.57; county pledge 2026-09-25; the December 2025 bill carries the member's 2025 general capital-credit retirement as a 142.51 bill credit (resolution approved 2025-11-18: the remaining 2003 margins, 18% of the 2018 margins and the 1998 G&T allocation of the Farm Patron Class plus 18% of the 2018 Residential margins, combined per member and paid to his oldest active account on the December bill) and he paid the net 119.52 on 2025-12-20; the 40.00 card payment on 2026-10-05; field collection fee and the 260.00 check on 2026-10-06; account_balance 656.88 = the seeded lines. Tenant house: eight periods from 2026-03, the Standard agreement of 2026-08-12, installment 1 on 2026-09-08, echeck returned with a 30.00 fee, late charge 2026-09-29, card 40.00, Round Up pledge 2026-10-02, notice of 2026-10-03 cleared after the 229.99 check of 2026-10-06, miss recorded 2026-10-04 at 176.42, and today's 2026-10 bill with a 6.10 billing error correction credit for the 2026-08-08 energy line (billed at the wrong quantity; the service charter posts a correction for the difference only); account_balance 95.10 = the seeded lines. No capital or deposit records are seeded: no factor of this task reads them. No courtesy late-charge waiver is seeded: both accounts had a returned payment, which the service charter's waiver rule excludes.
[Persona] Busy farmer calling from the combine; believes the plan was set up on Monday; asks only that the past-due be put onto it; phone and membership number on request; the rental house only if asked; generic passive consent to anything that must be done first; accepts in person by recorded consent only if told the plan still needs his agreement; ends when told the past-due is on the plan.
[Standard solution] Locate and verify; read accounts, agreements, ledgers, bill lines and payments; bill tenant installment 2 for 2026-10 at 65.95; default the tenant agreement billing back 127.77; read the 573.16 arranged amount to Dale and hand him the acceptance (recorded_phone_consent); move 488.16 into the farm agreement.
[Verification run] scratch harness (check_compute.build_env/eval_compute plus the real tools between steps): installment 65.95, default 127.77 (119.05 without the installment), acceptance 573.16, transfer 488.16 (559.01 without the acceptance); factor baselines as in the factor card. check_compute --task 1: COMPUTE OK.
[Draft recomputation from the visible context] The transfer rule sends the agent to the acceptance; the acceptance rule to the member's other agreements, where the tenant-house agreement is at its default count; the default rule to today's tenant bill; working the four rules in reverse order on the records gives 65.95, 127.77, 573.16 and 488.16.
[Known deviations] The installment, default and transfer entries' service-side bill lines are not written (this difficulty's tools write arrange tables only); the default applies a correction credit and a credit balance already standing on the service account (realism observation).
[Revision round 2 - audit audits/policy_task/payment_arrangement_agreements] T1-F1/D-F2: the default no longer applies the deposit, its interest or payable capital credits (the deposit and capital charters forbid it on an open account); its factors now read the latest bill's capital retirement and correction credits and a carried credit balance, rebill 105.37 (was 69.10). T1-F2: the persona no longer asks to take the plan; he believes it is set and asks for the past-due to go onto it, the acceptance arriving only as a passive branch; the 'another of your accounts' hint is now generic (T1-O1). T1-F3: the transfer is now the arranged amount recorded on acceptance less hold-backs, so the acceptance changes the moved amount (474.36 vs 512.71 without it); the 9999-12-31 sentinel and the past-due cap are gone (D-O4, D-O3, T1-O4). T1-F4/D-F3: late_charges_out_of_arrears relabelled parameter. T1-F5/D-F4b: deposit set-aside follows the deposit tier's first/later installment split; the seed holds the 180.00 first installment; arranged 605.66. D-O5: the transfer's action-form opening sentence removed. D-O7/T1-O2: the E3 effect no longer claims prior_defaults_allowed is read at acceptance. D-O2: transfer charge scope now stated as the latest billing period issued after the notice, matching compute. D-O9: the default rule's first sentence is a condition (missed entries at the default count), not an order between writes. D-O10: transfer docstring says 'accepted' rather than 'newly accepted'. D-F1: all results round half up exactly; no task 1 value changed by it. [Revision round 3 - audit audits/policy_task/payment_arrangement_agreements] R2-F1(a): the October capital-retirement credit 22.40 on the tenant-house bill is gone (the capital charter pays an active member's general retirement only on the December bills, and the member's payout goes to his oldest active account); the default no longer reads capital credits or the capital account: its factors are the credits applied by payment record (correction credits and the carried credit / correction credits alone / none), the carried-credit share, the correction share by returns and a new correction_timing_by_transfer share (corrected line billed on or before the balance transfer / after / no correction); the correction credit now corrects the 2026-08-08 energy line; tenant balance 95.10. R2-F1(b): the Farm Patron Class payable 46.30 is gone with the transfer's capital factor; the transfer's fourth factor is pledge_hold_by_age (pledge within the schedule's hold days / older within the lookback / none). R2-F2: correction credits are now applied on both payment-record tiers (with and without a return in 12 months), so correction_credit_share reaches 1 (no return in 12 months, second tier), 0.5 (return, first tier) and 0. Deposit rows checked against the deposit charter: the farm Farm Service Deposit's usage_reassessment basis is not producible (the tier's reassessment_allowed is false and the account was never disconnected, so no other basis applies either) and the tenant Residential Standard Deposit held since 2015 would have been refunded on a good 12-month review; both rows are removed, and the acceptance's deposit set-aside factor is replaced by down_payment_by_standing (every payment of the month with a notice and no return in 12 months / the month's payments other than checks with a notice and a return / the latest payment on or after the offer); a 40.00 card payment of 2026-10-05 is seeded on the farm home (balance 656.88). The capital and deposit read steps are dropped (calls now at steps 8, 10, 12, 14). Re-run: installment 65.95, default 127.77 (119.05 without the installment), acceptance 573.16, transfer 488.16 (559.01 without the acceptance).
user_scenario: You are Dale Wexler, sixty-four, and you farm corn and beans out on Mill Creek Road; you talk plainly and a little impatiently, because you are calling from the cab of the combine between loads. The farm home's electric account has a disconnect notice on it. On Monday a lady from the co-op went over a hardship payment plan with you for the past-due amount and you paid 40 dollars online with your card that evening, and on Tuesday when their field man came out to the meter you wrote him a check for 260 dollars, so as far as you know the plan is all set. You are calling today because you want the past-due on the farm home put onto that payment plan so they don't cut your power off in the middle of harvest. When the representative asks who you are, you give your phone number, 2705555704, and if they want another detail you give your membership number, 0457104. Only if they ask whether you have other accounts do you mention that the little rental house down the road at 6239 Mill Creek Rd is also in your name. You have no medical certificate on file. You do not know how any of the amounts are worked out and you leave that to them. If the representative tells you something else has to be taken care of first, you say fine, do what you have to do. If they tell you the plan still needs your agreement, then once they read you the amount you would be agreeing to and hand you the step to accept it, you accept it yourself right then by giving your consent on the recorded phone line; you do not let the representative accept it for you. Once you hear that the past-due has been moved onto the plan, you say good, that's what you needed, and you hang up to get back to the field.
